title: feat(console): the Studio landing is ordered by what the author came to do
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSqEJfSXXrgRvGw4hppNUc2)_

Fixes #34715

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzivEnnozveqZfr4fDx

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 首页改成按「要做什么」排：已安装的应用在最前，每张卡有「定制」按钮、不再显示「只读」和包 ID，没改动时写「还没有改动」；接着是「自己的应用」和「新建自己的应用」；最后是「不属于某个应用」：「岗位与权限」（原「环境目录」）和「未归属的流程 N」（为 0 时不显示）。说明缩成一句。托管环境里的系统包（`sys.` 开头）不再出现在「已安装的应用」里。
- 为什么改：最常做的事（改已安装的应用）原来排在最下面还标着「只读」；「可写基座」「.custom 定制包」「组织流程」「环境目录」是架构叫法。
- 风险与回滚：只改首页的顺序、文案和一个按钮，不改路由、权限、存储；新增 14 个界面文案键（en/zh）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`（未归属流程计数与 0 时隐藏那段 effect、已安装卡片）；`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`（新文案）。
- 两分钟验证：中文界面打开 `/_console/studio`，应看到第一块「已安装的应用」，卡片上有「定制」按钮，页面正文里没有「.custom」「基座」「只读」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Studio landing (`BuilderLanding.tsx`) is ordered by what the author came to do, and its copy says what they can do instead of naming the package mechanism.

- **A system package is not an installed app** (card comment 6943119575). A kernel package the server lists flat with a `system` / `cloud` scope stays in the package list tagged `kernel` (`parsePackages`); the landing drops it by that tag, the same predicate #34677's `offeredPackages` applies to the switcher (#34593). A manifest-scoped kernel package was already left out of the list.
- **Installed apps lead the page**, also when there are recent visits ("Recently viewed" now follows the author's own apps, among the other entries). One hint line under the heading: the app is upgraded by its vendor, the author's changes are kept separately. Each card carries a **Customize** button that opens the app in Studio exactly as clicking the card does (`/studio/<id>/data`). The Read-only badge is gone; the package id is no longer on the card's face (it is the card's `title`). Zero changes read "No changes yet" instead of "0 customized, 0 switched off". The marketplace link sits beside the heading.
- **Your own apps** follow, with the create card renamed **New app of your own** (was "New package (writable base)") and a one-line description; the old empty state "No writable packages yet" is replaced by that card.
- **Outside any app** comes last: **Positions and permissions** (was "Environment catalog"; still opens `/studio/~all/metadata`, ADR-0146 D1, name and description only) and **Flows in no app N** (was "Organization flows"). The count comes from `loadPackageLessSurfaces(client, 'flow', locale)`, the same read the `/studio/~org/automations` scope uses; the card is hidden when the count is 0, and shows without a number if the read fails.
- The lead is one sentence.
- 14 new keys in the studio namespace (en + zh, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/`); no edit to the eager `locales/en.ts`, no second loader. Superseded keys stay in the catalogue (listed in the changeset); `engine.studio.org.name` and `engine.studio.pkg.new` are still read by `PackageSwitcher`.
- Checklist item `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` (revision 4) now opens the org scope directly when no package-less flow exists, since the landing draws no entry then. A CLI integration test's comment names the new heading key.

No route, permission or storage change.

## Tests

<details><summary>New and updated tests (11 landing files, 63 tests pass)</summary>

- New `BuilderLanding.taskOrder-34715.test.tsx` (7): two flat `sys.*` rows parsed by the real `parsePackages` (control: both tagged `kernel`) draw no card, no Customize and no name (fails with the filter removed); heading order; Customize opens `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data`; no id on the card face, id in `title`, lines `6 customized, 1 switched off` / `No changes yet`; Positions and permissions → `/studio/~all/metadata`; en body has no `.custom` / `read-only` / `writable base`; zh body has none of `.custom` / `基座` / `只读` and shows `未归属的流程2`.
- `BuilderLanding.orgScope-11553`: count 2 + navigation, hidden at 0, no number when the read fails.
- `BuilderLanding.recentPackages-11863`: new case, with a recent visit the h2 order is Installed apps, Your own apps, Recently viewed, Outside any app.
- `customizationCounts-28566`, `customizeCopy-29489`, `environmentOverlayCopy-12171`, `accessibleNames-12510`, `newPackageDeepLink-26614`, `setupExit-12513`: pins moved to the new copy and test ids; each file doubles the package-less flow read so no request leaves it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

Premise lines of #34715 measured on `origin/main` f6f5b50a0 before this PR: the lead (`engine.studio.landing.description`, zh :3005), 「我的软件包(可写)」/「还没有可写软件包」/「新建软件包(可写基座)」, the org-scope card (`BuilderLanding.tsx:438`) and env-catalog card (:457) under 「不属于软件包」, and the installed section last (:485) with the read-only badge (:518) and the id on the card face (:515) all hold as written. `check-prior-rulings --card 34715`: thread none; ADR-0146 D1 (positions and permissions stay in Studio) is honoured by renaming only.

Live readings (real showcase backend `objectstack dev --fresh`, console from this branch's source, zh-CN and en). Scripts, readings and screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34715-live/` (project share).

1. zh-CN body has no 「.custom」「基座」「只读」; first block 已安装的应用; the card shows 定制 and 还没有改动, no id. With a recent visit the h2 order is 已安装的应用 / 自己的应用 / 最近访问 / 不属于某个应用 (en: Installed apps / Your own apps / Recently viewed / Outside any app).
2. No package-less flow: no 未归属的流程 card. After two package-less flows were written through `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/<name>` (200): 未归属的流程 2 / Flows in no app 2, clicking opens `/studio/~org/automations`.
3. Hosted-environment system packages: the real `GET /api/v1/packages` answer with two flat rows appended (`sys.package-state` scope `system`, `sys.env-artifact-cache` scope `cloud`): installed cards `["com.example.showcase"]`, no `sys.*` card, no system package name in the body, en and zh. Before-leg with the filter removed, same stand-in: the two `sys.*` cards draw.
4. Customize → `/studio/com.example.showcase/data`; 岗位与权限 / Positions and permissions → `/studio/~all/metadata`. At 375 px the page has no horizontal scroll and Customize is 48×44 px.

Scope note: the card's step 1 names a "customizations in this environment" block between installed apps and the rest; that is #34714, which builds on this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (on d247d947e; the delta to 19bfd599a re-ran landing tests, app-shell type-check, ESLint, test-source-alias, changeset-fixed, overlap-check, all exit 0)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding`: 11 files, 63 tests pass on 19bfd599a.
- studio-design directory: 334/335 files pass in the full run; `DataPillar.validationVerdictHold-27644` (e) timed out at 15 s under shared-box load and passes alone (9/9); the file is untouched here.
- metadata-admin 4 files 156 pass; `@object-ui/i18n` 102 files, 1894 pass, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and i18n type-check: exit 0. ESLint on changed files: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 70): all exit 0. Three were first red for environment reasons and re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, 48 cases pass after fetch), `vitest run scripts/` in ui (SIGKILL under memory; 171 files / 5077 tests pass at `--maxWorkers=2`), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needed spec+lint+rest+cli dist; 124 entries load after a serial build). `check:test-source-alias` red on two edited tests, fixed by a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`.
- Console build exit 0; `pnpm check:eager-closure` exit 0. **i18n-locale-en: 60.2 KB of the 60.5 KB ceiling** (0.4 KB headroom; this PR does not touch `locales/en.ts`). Aggregate 1892.9 KB / 2431.6 KB.
- `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` exit 0; `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations; platform-checklist and type-check-debt OK.
- `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean (#34677 shares the studio en/zh files and merges cleanly).

</details>

Deviations: the branch is this thread's pinned branch `claude/project-thread-eqwj27`, not `claude/issue-34715-*`. The author's own (writable) cards keep their id and Writable badge; the card's hide-the-id item names installed cards only.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; ESLint passes on every changed file.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
